key_provisions_or_claims: NBTC Office notification of 12 May 2026 requires standards inspection and certification of radio equipment in multipurpose mobile robots.
Operators must file lists of radio communication equipment electronically and keep import, distribution and sales records for traceability.
Scope covers self-propelled, programmable robots of 10 kg or more with a 3+ axis arm or legged/wheeled mobility.
No specific penalties yet; voluntary cooperation basis, with mandatory rules expected.
Second article covers proposed relaxation of Thailand's foreign business restrictions (not robot-related).
annotation.summary_en: Law-firm newsletter (May 2026) summarising a Thai NBTC Office notification that subjects multipurpose mobile robots using radio communication equipment to standards inspection, certification and equipment-list filing for traceability and public safety. Also covers proposed easing of foreign business restrictions under Thailand's Foreign Business Act.
annotation.title_clean: Thailand Legal Update No.45: Thailand Tightens Regulatory Requirements for Multipurpose Mobile Robots
